svg.title: Three deterministic BSP dungeon examples
svg.desc: Real CLI output for width 40 height 20 seed 42, comparing depth zero, depth six and larger rooms.

g.text: Same 40 × 20 grid and seed 42; change depth and minimum room size.
Depth is a limit, not a target. Larger minimum rooms can stop subdivision earlier.
Rooms can touch or merge; the generator guarantees connected floor, not separating walls.
